name: Eclipse Blade
description:
About This Game

Eclipse Blade is a retro ninja action-platformer inspired by classic late-NES-era ninja games.

An eclipse has opened the Eclipse Gate. From it, ancient evil soldiers pour into the human world. Darkness is spreading. Humanity is on the verge of destruction.

You, as the chosen ninja, take up your katana and ninja skills, fight through the evil army, and destroy the darkness at its source.

Features:

  • Challenging old-school action-platformer gameplay

  • Fully hand-crafted pixel art in a late-NES style

  • Different types of ninja skills — Blade and Ninjutsu — let you fight in different ways

  • Also includes optional hardcore and speedrun modes (not available in the Demo)
short_desc: Eclipse Blade is a retro ninja action-platformer inspired by classic ninja games from the late-NES era. Featuring challenging old-school gameplay and beautifully hand-crafted pixel art, it delivers the pure thrill of classic action in a fresh new way.
